snippet.title: prettysmart games 👻🏨 THE SPIRIT LIFT Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Pick your team, collect cards, battle creatures, and resurrect the hotel in 👻🏨 THE SPIRIT LIFT by prettysmart games on January 27, 2026. Dare to take ride on this survival horror roguelike deckbuilder?

Wishlist on Steam and play the demo! ▶️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/1727590/THE_SPIRIT_LIFT/

This trailer originally appeared during @DreadXPGames and @MediaIndieExchange Indie Horror Showcase 2025. Thank you for inviting us! Catch the full showcase: https://youtu.be/kCPsooeH12A?si=Bhgt1AR2J7hTyNRi&t=3760

#indie #horror #gametrailers
